resources.string: ListenBrainz Android needs to remain active in foreground at all times to immediately sync music activity to ListenBrainz. Whenever a user starts listening to a song, the song is instantly synced with ListenBrainz in the form of Playing now and when some duration of the song elapses without interruption, it is marked as a confirmed listen. Stats are calculated in real time using this data which makes real time behavior of the app important.
